business_summary.text: Amagi Media Labs Limited is a cloud-native SaaS platform serving the global media and entertainment industry, enabling media companies to launch, manage, distribute, and monetize live, linear, and on-demand content across cable, OTT, and FAST platforms without traditional broadcast infrastructure.

call_points.text: Gross margin guided to stay in the 67-69% band for this year, with Q3 seasonally strong.
No formal revenue guidance; management aspires to maintain current growth rates but flags Q2 base-effect headwind.
Revenue ₹437 Cr, up 32% YoY and 21% in constant currency, the highest quarterly revenue on record.
Gross margin 67.3%, down 2.2 points YoY on mix, live-event intensity and prior-year base; up 0.5 point QoQ.
DSO improved about 8 days sequentially; Q1 is structurally the weakest cash quarter on incentives and renewals.
M&A: 33 opportunities evaluated since January, 23 passed, 10 under active evaluation; no binding commitments.
AI: 10 active Newspulse pilots and a major U.S. news network selected the platform; revenue impact expected later this year.
Q2FY27 faces a ~600 bps YoY headwind from last year's revenue-recognition timing benefit.
AI pricing model still evolving; management sees no material deflationary impact yet but will wait a few quarters for clarity.

timeline.summary: Amagi announces cloud-based broadcast modernization for AccuWeather, expanding their 2021 FAST channels engagement
Amagi launched its In-Content Ads offering via the ADS PLUS marketplace for connected TV advertisers.
Amagi announced its largest CLOUDPORT platform upgrade, supporting 100+ concurrent feeds with 200-player multi-AZ redundancy, available in the ongoing 4.x release cycle.
Amagi received an Income Tax assessment order for AY 2023-24 on May 14, 2026 proposing a ₹17.91 Cr adjustment and will appeal before the appellate authority.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹396.97 Cr, net profit ₹34.26 Cr.
Amagi Media Labs reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,506 Cr, up 30% YoY, and a net profit of ₹72 Cr, marking its first full year of profitability at scale.
Amagi's Q1FY27 earnings call reported revenue of ₹437 Cr, up 32% YoY, adjusted EBITDA of ₹50 Cr at an 11.5% margin, and PAT of ₹34 Cr.
2026-10-20: Amagi schedules Q2FY27 earnings conference call for November 06, 2026
